composition_strategy: Create a composition featuring a frontal view of dense foliage, with a strong focus on a left-side cluster of leaves and stems. The foliage will spill outwards towards the right, creating an asymmetrical balance. Use receding planes to imply depth, with the most detailed and vibrant foliage in the foreground gradually softening towards the background. The overall shape aims for a dynamic, asymmetric cluster within the frame.

safe_region_strategy.title: Create a clear, uncluttered title safe area along the top third of the image, utilizing a lighter tonal variation within the foliage. This will ensure legibility of any overlaid text without disrupting the botanical garden atmosphere.
safe_region_strategy.programme: Designate a programme safe-space along the bottom right edge of the image, employing a subtle shift in tonal value or texture within the foliage to differentiate it from the primary background. Maintain the overall botanical theme while providing a clear contrast for overlaid information.
